versions.content: When the LIN Interface has started the sleep mode transition and the upper layer requests a wake-up before the sleep mode transition is completed, the LIN Interface shall not invoke the function <User>_GotoSleepConfirmation and restart the wakeup process by calling the function Lin_Wakeup to wake-up the channel again.
